text:
marta: Quick postmortem follow-up for Aurantia onprem peering incident — who can take ownership of the remaining items? TL;DR: asymmetric routing from a stale on-prem peering policy + firewall state caused isolation for ~18m. We agreed on remediation owners in the call but need tracked tasks and dates.

omar: I can own the infra changes for peering config and the automation to detect stale BGP sessions.

lia: I'll own the customer-facing checklist and coordinate the patch window with Aurantia CS. Lia -> @jia for availability.

jia: available next Tue/Wed for the maintenance window. I'll also ask for their firewall team to confirm stateful timeout settings.

devin: I'll add a regression test to the Dedicated test harness to simulate asymmetric route return paths. Low-effort smoke test first. ETA 1 sprint.

omar: Proposed concrete action items (short):
- A1 (omar): Add BGP-health probe + alert when peer ASN flaps >3x in 10m. ETA: 2w.
- A2 (omar/devin): Add automated route-consistency checker to CI (simulate advertised prefixes vs observed). ETA: 3w.
- A3 (lia): Update customer runbook + maintenance playbook with forced rollback steps and firewall ask-list. ETA: 1w.
- A4 (devin): Add a CI test that injects asymmetric return path and asserts request-level retry/fallback works. ETA: next sprint.
- A5 (marta): Run a cross-team tabletop with CS+Infra to verify ownership alignment. Date: within 7 days.

marta: Adding one more: A6 (omar): create a short runbook snippet to be included in Dedicated onboarding docs about common onprem NAT/firewall timeouts and CIDR overlap pitfalls. ETA: 2w.

lia: I'm going to track these in the incident tracker. Linking tasks as: 2248001234-A1..A6 in the sheet. Will ping daily until owners confirm.

omar: For A1/A2, I started a branch: `infra/aurantia-peering-watch`. Basic probe plan: periodically BGP open health check + passive flow samples to correlate with request failures.

infra-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/9842 (infra/aurantia-peering-watch) — reviewer: @omar

devin: Sample check command for onprem lab to reproduce the symptom:
```bash
# on lab router run:
ip route add 10.40.0.0/16 via 192.0.2.1
# then abuse return path by blocking 192.0.2.1 on egress firewall
curl -v https://aurantia.private/api/health || true
```

lia: I added the maintenance checklist items we discussed to the sheet: confirmation of firewall conntrack timeouts, verify symmetric route table entries, validate BGP session persistence.

omar: Risk note: until A1 is in place, we should treat any peering config changes as high-risk and require two approvers. I'll update the change template.

marta: Scheduling: weekly check-ins until all A1..A6 are closed. Next sync: 2248004800 (one week from now). Add status updates here only — if something blocks, escalate to @devops-oncall.

jia: I'll confirm Aurantia's firewall timeout and get back by EOD tomorrow.

omar: assigning tasks in JIRA: AUR-PEER-101..106 (owners aligned). I'll paste links once created.

lia: thanks — marking action owners as confirmed: Omar (A1,A2,A6), Lia (A3), Devin (A4), Marta (A5).

marta: Perfect. Closing the loop: please post short daily statuses (one-liners) into this thread until A1..A6 are done. :thumbsup:

devin: quick status: started CI test skeleton, blocked on test env subnet setup. Filing infra request now.

infra-bot: Jira issues created: https://jira.redwood/browse/AUR-PEER-101 https://jira.redwood/browse/AUR-PEER-102 https://jira.redwood/browse/AUR-PEER-103

marta: Awesome. If anyone hits a blocker, call it out and we will reassign. Thanks all.

jia: FYI Aurantia sent their firewall config — looks like conntrack timeout set to 20s, which is shorter than our default keepalives. I'll add details to the sheet.

omar: noted. I'll adjust probe frequency to account for short conntrack windows and include a mitigation doc: `if conntrack < 60s -> reduce keepalive interval or request firewall change`.

marta: End of thread for now — we'll use this as the canonical follow-up tracker.
